title: 第17章 谄媚的林鬼第18章 深情的一对小情侣
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 沉重的卡兰城门在讨伐队身后缓缓闭合，将城内喧嚣与窥探的目光彻底隔绝。
城外旷野的风，带着一股原始的粗粝感，吹得旗帜猎猎作响。
方才在民众面前还队列整齐、气势如虹的王都骑士团。
几乎在城门落锁的瞬间就松弛了下来。
为首的里昂骑士打了个手势，骑士们纷纷利落地翻身下马。
动作娴熟地将战马拴在一旁的临时桩上。
显然，接下来的路程，他们不打算再维持那套，耀眼的骑兵阵势了。
作秀结束，现在该办“正事“了。
队伍沉默地转向黑魔森林的方向，开始步行。
气氛陡然变得压抑而真实，铠甲摩擦声和脚步声在寂静的旷野中，显得格外清晰。
或许是被这沉闷的气氛所躁，又或许是脱离了公众视野后，便肆无忌惮。
队伍中一名走在侧翼、脸上带着一道疤的战士骑士，目光屡次瞟向希娅。
精灵与魔族血统结合带来的绝世容颜，游侠职业锻炼出的矫健而曼妙的身材。
以及那双既纯真又妖异的赤瞳，无一不在挑战着某些人的自制力。
那战士舔了舔有些干裂的嘴唇。
趁着队伍行进间一个轻微的拥挤，装作脚下不稳。
那只戴着铁手套的大手，便极其自然又迅疾地朝着希娅摸去。
然而，他的手还在半空。
一道冰冷的寒芒就如同毒蛇般，悄无声息地抵在了他的喉结上！
希娅甚至没有完全转身，只是手腕一翻。
一柄淬炼过的短匕已然出鞘，精准地定格在那里。
再进一分便能刺穿皮革与血肉。
她的眼神冰冷锐利，如同盯上猎物的雌豹，没有丝毫波动。
那战士的动作僵住了，脸上的猥琐瞬间化为惊愕和一丝恐惧。
他能清晰地感受到匕首尖传来的死亡凉意。
“你干什么？！“
旁边的骑士们立刻察觉不对，纷纷呵斥，手按上了武器。
紧张的气氛瞬间引爆。
就在骑士们即将发作的瞬间。
林鬼猛地向前一步，用尽全力，声音洪亮得甚至有些破音地大吼道：
“报告里昂骑士长！这位骑士意图非礼希娅小姐！！“
这一嗓子如同惊雷，瞬间把所有人的注意力都吸引了过去。
齐刷刷地聚焦在那名战士骑士依旧僵在半空、意图不轨的手上。
事实上，不少骑士刚才也或多或少被希娅的身姿容貌吸引。
只是没那个胆量付诸行动。
此刻被林鬼这么赤裸裸地喊破，脸上都有些挂不住。
一时间竟无人出声反驳。
希娅也因林鬼这突如其来的“告状“愣了一下。
但她反应极快，手腕一抖收回匕首。
同时脚步一错，下意识地将林鬼稍稍拉向自己身后。
目光警惕地锁定了里昂骑士，全身肌肉紧绷，防备着对方的发难。
content_en:
The heavy Kallan City Gate slowly closed behind the expedition team, completely isolating the hustle and bustle in the city from prying eyes.
The wind in the wilderness outside the city had a primitive roughness, making the flags rustle.
The Royal Capital Knights had just formed a neat formation in front of the people and were full of momentum.
He relaxed almost as soon as the city gate was locked.
The leading Lyon knight made a gesture, and all the knights turned over and dismounted neatly.
He skillfully tied the war horse to a temporary stake nearby.
Obviously, they no longer intend to maintain that dazzling cavalry formation for the rest of the journey.
The show is over, now it’s time to get down to business.
The team turned silently in the direction of the Dark Demon Forest and started walking.
The atmosphere suddenly became oppressive and real, and the sound of armor scraping and footsteps seemed particularly clear in the silent wilderness.
Perhaps he was agitated by the dull atmosphere, or perhaps he became unscrupulous after being out of the public eye.
A warrior knight in the team who was walking on the flank with a scar on his face glanced at Shia many times.
The combination of elf and demon blood brings a peerless appearance, and the ranger profession creates a strong and graceful figure.
As well as those innocent and enchanting red eyes, they all challenge some people's self-control.
The soldier licked his chapped lips.
Taking advantage of a slight crowding in the procession, he pretended to be unsteady on his feet.
The big hand wearing an iron glove moved toward Sia very naturally and quickly.
However, his hand was still in mid-air.
An icy cold light was like a poisonous snake, silently touching his Adam's apple!
Shia didn't even turn around completely, just flipped her wrist.
A tempered dagger has been unsheathed and is accurately fixed there.
One more step and it would pierce leather and flesh.
Her eyes were cold and sharp, like a female leopard staring at its prey, without any fluctuation.
The soldier's movements froze, and the wretchedness on his face instantly turned into shock and a hint of fear.
He could clearly feel the coolness of death coming from the tip of the dagger.
"What are you doing?!"
The knights next to him immediately realized something was wrong, scolded them one after another, and put their hands on their weapons.
The tense atmosphere exploded instantly.
Just when the knights were about to attack.
Lin Gui suddenly took a step forward, used all his strength, and shouted in a loud and even broken voice:
"Report to Knight Commander Lyon! This knight intends to molest Miss Shia!!"
This voice was like thunder, instantly attracting everyone's attention.
All focused on the hand of the warrior knight who was still frozen in mid-air with evil intentions.
In fact, many knights were more or less attracted to Xia's appearance just now.
I just don't have the guts to take action.
At this moment, being shouted out so nakedly by Lin Gui, his face was a little embarrassed.
For a moment, no one spoke up to refute.
Xia was also stunned by Lin Gui's sudden "complaint".
But she reacted very quickly and retracted the dagger with a flick of her wrist.
At the same time, he made a wrong step and subconsciously pulled Lin Gui slightly behind him.
His eyes were fixed on the Lyon Knight with vigilance, and his muscles were tense, guarding against the opponent's attack.
